### [`admin/blog-editor/delete/route.ts`](../../app/api/admin/blog-editor/delete/route.ts)

Route `/api/admin/blog-editor/delete` (route).

- `POST` _function_: Deletion mirrors the save flow: nothing touches `main` directly. A branch is forked, every per-locale markdown file is removed in its own commit, and a draft PR is opened for review — the post only disappears once a human merges it.

Route `/api/admin/blog-editor/posts/[key]` (route).

- `GET` _function_: Load every locale file belonging to one post (matched by translationKey or the source-locale slug) and hand the editor back a ready-to-hydrate draft payload.

### [`admin/blog-editor/posts/route.ts`](../../app/api/admin/blog-editor/posts/route.ts)

Route `/api/admin/blog-editor/posts` (route).

- `GET` _function_: Walk every `content/blog/<locale>/*.md`, group by translationKey (falling back to the slug for posts that don't declare one yet) and return a flat summary list for the editor's "Open existing post" picker.

### [`admin/blog-editor/save/route.ts`](../../app/api/admin/blog-editor/save/route.ts)

### [`media/[...id]/route.ts`](../../app/api/media/%5B...id%5D/route.ts)

Route `/api/media/[...id]` (route).

- `GET` _function_
- `dynamic` _const_: Dynamic for the same reason as the collection route: `?locale=` selects the language of the resolved text, and a statically prerendered response would answer every locale with whichever one the build happened to render.

### [`media/route.ts`](../../app/api/media/route.ts)

Route `/api/media` (route).

- `GET` _function_
- `dynamic` _const_: MUST stay dynamic: every filter arrives as a query parameter, and `force-static` prerenders the route once with an EMPTY query and then serves that one response for every request — so `?q=…` silently returned the entire catalog.
